*Bacillus subtilis* ZB183 is `a genetically engineered probiotic bacterium created to break down acetaldehyde—a toxic byproduct of alcohol metabolism—in the gut` . It is the active ingredient in ZBiotics Pre-Alcohol, marketed as the first commercially available genetically engineered probiotic.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLxPS4_MRe21yyhO4eauMl8Si6NMxDhXav3yL12y2PR9u9pAjf1G1b6Xl1_G7dBQrDUpz0JhnLpw-WjOsJgETZr3r0PzFC-OIk8EXt8rhz-VZGY-X6ipjzQ9HGVBUTpsAoCECQr_fzYmV)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX-wXT1H-b9UnsI2xSSHarO2ALTlApk0eoKLSglKPvBFk-ln2ELRbKGZslcw1uiNmt7WHKVcAwu7IudnYuojMNM7EKm2bFzY5oeVknwFBcLD3QQnMhvWxRpXr0O1ntndOpE9E5zqyr)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXX1JKSPyPLqs3ZotV3YOP5LOsDtvI20ZuxXZPEhA-e-fubQhq_jEIVxl7frVKMLfn-82IUDs7svlBofJVAVG3_XQW7T7wOQEHbE1S0SHwcDGkt8wwHZ5EIpByOKWr9eNXD0y5MTNBxQ03e4A)

### How It Works

- **Parent Strain:** Built on *B. subtilis* PY79, a well-studied laboratory strain lacking many mobile genetic elements found in other *B. subtilis* strains.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLxPS4_MRe21yyhO4eauMl8Si6NMxDhXav3yL12y2PR9u9pAjf1G1b6Xl1_G7dBQrDUpz0JhnLpw-WjOsJgETZr3r0PzFC-OIk8EXt8rhz-VZGY-X6ipjzQ9HGVBUTpsAoCECQr_fzYmV)
- **Genetic Modification:** Engineered to continuously express an acetaldehyde dehydrogenase enzyme (AcoD) originally from *Cupriavidus necator*.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLxPS4_MRe21yyhO4eauMl8Si6NMxDhXav3yL12y2PR9u9pAjf1G1b6Xl1_G7dBQrDUpz0JhnLpw-WjOsJgETZr3r0PzFC-OIk8EXt8rhz-VZGY-X6ipjzQ9HGVBUTpsAoCECQr_fzYmV)
- **Mechanism:** Converts acetaldehyde into acetic acid (acetate) using the cofactor NAD+, helping reduce acetaldehyde buildup in the digestive tract.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXX1JKSPyPLqs3ZotV3YOP5LOsDtvI20ZuxXZPEhA-e-fubQhq_jEIVxl7frVKMLfn-82IUDs7svlBofJVAVG3_XQW7T7wOQEHbE1S0SHwcDGkt8wwHZ5EIpByOKWr9eNXD0y5MTNBxQ03e4A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLxPS4_MRe21yyhO4eauMl8Si6NMxDhXav3yL12y2PR9u9pAjf1G1b6Xl1_G7dBQrDUpz0JhnLpw-WjOsJgETZr3r0PzFC-OIk8EXt8rhz-VZGY-X6ipjzQ9HGVBUTpsAoCECQr_fzYmV)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX-wXT1H-b9UnsI2xSSHarO2ALTlApk0eoKLSglKPvBFk-ln2ELRbKGZslcw1uiNmt7WHKVcAwu7IudnYuojMNM7EKm2bFzY5oeVknwFBcLD3QQnMhvWxRpXr0O1ntndOpE9E5zqyr)

### Safety & Evidence

- **Preclinical Toxicity:** A 90-day repeat-dose oral study in rats found no adverse effects up to the highest tested dose of 10¹¹ CFU/kg body weight/day.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXAc85IINAZxeNjpySOjq6V5SWd28wFADbR0I8VIMLxcXilQd6T-U7M0L_vb6oyVB4XQ6BgdODG2NghPzh66RL9loIbtaX-ldybdd3QqRxTGrWFoXWMk-FjeTEDcZZwdrBr1VrXdJOQdY)
- **Clinical Context:** While designed to target acetaldehyde generated during alcohol consumption, independent clinical evidence on hangover prevention remains limited, and it does not prevent alcohol intoxication or harm from heavy drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX-wXT1H-b9UnsI2xSSHarO2ALTlApk0eoKLSglKPvBFk-ln2ELRbKGZslcw1uiNmt7WHKVcAwu7IudnYuojMNM7EKm2bFzY5oeVknwFBcLD3QQnMhvWxRpXr0O1ntndOpE9E5zqyr)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF10EsjObQDsOW5EbdOxI5Ihy4-P187TpgaI_DoE4o0LitkO1Ck0t9PR5gJ7StjzEYiJLP3-X2ADagfgys4Q0YJ6wcj3_RwUGniVksrf2LkDi9-GDjrfQbiN_COeHQRZYkhmWSlEeTFf-h2MQF6H3RIHrTFEqoJuE1sCSbq1E7oQVH9hBhiw)

For further reading on its safety and development, see the 90-day oral toxicity study on [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXLxPS4_MRe21yyhO4eauMl8Si6NMxDhXav3yL12y2PR9u9pAjf1G1b6Xl1_G7dBQrDUpz0JhnLpw-WjOsJgETZr3r0PzFC-OIk8EXt8rhz-VZGY-X6ipjzQ9HGVBUTpsAoCECQr_fzYmV) or a review of engineered probiotics on [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXX1JKSPyPLqs3ZotV3YOP5LOsDtvI20ZuxXZPEhA-e-fubQhq_jEIVxl7frVKMLfn-82IUDs7svlBofJVAVG3_XQW7T7wOQEHbE1S0SHwcDGkt8wwHZ5EIpByOKWr9eNXD0y5MTNBxQ03e4A).Are you looking for **clinical evidence** on effectiveness, **safety/side effects** , or **how ZBiotics compares** to other alcohol-related supplements?
